root_cause.text: In `mlx5e_ipsec_disable_events()`, the code unconditionally dereferences `peer_priv->ipsec` without first checking if the IPsec structure is allocated, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the device does not support IPsec.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a guard `if (peer_priv && peer_priv->ipsec)` before accessing `peer_priv->ipsec->comp`. The crash trace shows a page fault at `_raw_spin_lock_irqsave` while trying to lock `peer_priv->ipsec->comp`, and the commit message explicitly states the crash occurs because IPsec resources are cleaned up even when the device doesn't support IPsec.
